description: This file defines two classes, PairwiseDistance and CosineSimilarity, which are modules for computing pairwise distances and cosine similarity between input tensors, respectively, within the PyTorch framework.

classes.name: PairwiseDistance
classes.description: A module to compute pairwise distances between input vectors or matrices using p-norm.

classes.name: CosineSimilarity
classes.description: A module to compute cosine similarity between two input tensors along a specified dimension.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the module with parameters for norm degree, epsilon, and whether to keep dimensions.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Executes the forward pass to compute the distance or similarity.
